_comment: The server switcher's monogram rule, as literal cases: the name, its letters, its colour. Go (internal/ui serverMonogram, serverMonogramColour; TestTheMonogram) and the script (web/static/servers.js monogram, monogramColour; e2e/servers.test.mjs) are both held to this one table. The colours were computed apart from either implementation (32-bit FNV-1a over the name's UTF-16 code units, modulo the eight-colour palette). The last cases cover the ways Go and a browser could disagree, which the rule avoids: an iota-subscript letter (Go's simple ToUpper gives titlecase, JavaScript's full mapping two letters: kept as it is), an old letter given an uppercase in Unicode 16 (ƛ to U+A7DC, outside the blocks: kept as it is) and a letter newer than Go's Unicode 15 tables (U+1C8A, Unicode 16: a word start in both, kept as it is).
